channel.title: Karamo
channel.desc: Jimmy says that, while incarcerated, he unexpectedly crossed paths with Kristen, who he believes is his long-lost sister; she says that when she brought up the possibility to her father, she was met with resistance and told never to bring it up again; Dexter is convinced that his girlfriend, Norma, is cheating, and he believes it's with a family friend; he says a suspicious voicemail, long disappearances and her lack of quality time with him all point to infidelity.
